groups.pattern: Performance: repeated disk I/O without caching
groups.fix_shape: Add TTL cache or file-mtime-based cache

issues.title: `verify_crypto_hash_comparison` Re-reads Unchanged Chunks Unnecessarily
issues.suggestion: Pre-compute all-zeros hash once, skip re-reading chunks whose before-hash differs from it.

issues.title: `load_policy()` Called on Every API Request
issues.suggestion: Add a TTL cache (e.g., `functools.lru_cache` with a TTL wrapper) or a file-mtime-based cache to avoid re-reading unchanged policy.

issues.title: `get_discovery_max_workers` / `get_background_smart_max_workers` Load Policy on Every Call
issues.suggestion: Consider caching with short TTL or file-mtime check if discovery frequency increases.

issues.title: `_job_interrupted` flag never reset after signal
issues.suggestion: Reset `_job_interrupted = False` at the start of each `run_erase_job` call, or use a per-job interruption flag instead of a module-level flag.

issues.title: `bay_map.json` reloaded on every udev event
issues.suggestion: Cache with file mtime check or use inotify-based file watcher.

groups.fix_shape: Add locks around shared mutable state or restructure lock scope

issues.title: `smart_test_update_thread` Global Without Lock

issues.title: Signal Handler Uses `threading.Lock` — Potential Deadlock
issues.suggestion: Use `threading.Event` instead of `Lock`+boolean. `Event.set()` and `Event.is_set()` are lock-free and async-signal-safe in CPython.
